definitions.explanation: Acting in a forceful manner without considering others' feelings or objections.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強引|ごういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}させようとした→契約する：02698_keiyaku⟧。
examples.english: He tried to force me into signing the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{強引|ごういん}なやり⟦{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Such a forceful approach is not good.

examples.japanese: {強引|ごういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: He pushed the discussion forward forcefully.

notes:
{強引|ごういん} describes someone acting forcefully without regard for others' feelings or objections. It almost always carries a negative connotation.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {強引|ごういん}な (e.g. {強引|ごういん}なやり⟦{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧, a forceful method)
- Adverbial: {強引|ごういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (e.g. {強引|ごういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧, to push forward forcefully)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強引|ごういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧: to pressure someone into coming
- {強引|ごういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide forcefully
- {強引|ごういん}な⟦{勧誘|かんゆう}→勧誘：16850_kanyuu⟧: aggressive solicitation
- {強引|ごういん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: overbearing attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無理|むり}やり→無理やり：10526_muriyari⟧: by force, forcibly (adverb, emphasizes coercion)
- ⟦{押|お}し→押す：02854_osu⟧が⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: pushy, assertive (can be neutral or mildly negative)
- ⟦{横暴|おうぼう}→横暴：07988_oubou⟧: tyrannical, despotic (stronger negative meaning)
